scope: Group emoji/GIF/sticker toolbar and registry shortcuts use shared pickers. Emoji replaces the selected text; independent GIF/sticker sends preserve the main draft, files and reply, reject existing pending operations and retain account/session/group/key-epoch/navigation guards.

Group message bodies use the shared formatting/expression renderer. Inline GIF/custom emoji/sticker media remains behind private group media classification/annotation policy and the existing spam/ignore gate; failed decrypted bodies do not render stale plaintext.

Persistent group pin list/pin/unpin APIs enforce current membership, same-group message identity and expected account. Pin metadata is additive; encrypted payloads are unchanged. Group members can manage group pins, without changing channel role permissions.

Ctrl+P, a header control and message pin action open a scoped decrypted pin panel. Confirmed unpin, retry/error states, encrypted attachments and missing-key states are implemented. Original-socket-scoped pin/edit/delete invalidations refresh the open panel.

Group pin limit is fifty, enforced atomically; PostgreSQL uses a per-group transaction lock. Existing pins remain idempotent at the cap, unpin frees a slot, and existing lists are never truncated to conceal legacy records.
